description: Search for stays that fit within a budget for a given duration. Country is OPTIONAL - can search globally or filter by specific country. Perfect for queries like 'Find me somewhere to stay for 1 month under EUR 1000' or 'Find me a place in Spain for 1 month under EUR 1000'.

checkInDate.description: OPTIONAL: Check-in date. Can be a full date (e.g., '2026-05-15'), a month name (e.g., 'May' ? uses May 1st), or omit for today (2026-01-19)

continent.description: OPTIONAL: Continent name (e.g., 'Europe', 'Asia', 'Africa'). Filters results to stays in countries on this continent. If omitted, searches all continents globally.

countryCode.description: OPTIONAL: 2-letter country code (e.g., 'ES', 'PT') or country name (e.g., 'Spain'). If omitted, searches all countries globally.

durationDays.description: Duration of stay in days (e.g., 30 for 1 month, 90 for 3 months)

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 15)

maxPrice.description: Maximum price for the entire duration (e.g., 1000 for EUR 1000)

name: getStaysByBudget
